notes.title: Quartet Out Now! Plus new RPG Release Dates!
notes.content:
[p]Huge news from the Infinite Alliance! 🚨[/p][h1]Quartet is Out Now![/h1][p]Quartet by Something Classic is OUT NOW on Steam 🥳 I've been lucky enough to play a pre-release build of the game, and I truly think it's a must-play RPG that's well worth your time - especially if you love classic Final Fantasy.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1307960/Quartet/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Please support this amazing team of passionate developers! Plus, you'll get to learn all about Alexandra before her appearance in Infinite Alliance 😉[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="x1dtKybfyaE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]Release Dates[/h1][p]Two other Infinite Alliance games have just announced release dates which are coming up [b]fast[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]Shrine's Legacy[/b] launches on the 7th of October on Steam! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435410/Shrines_Legacy/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Kingdoms of the Dump[/b] launches in November on Steam![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2159270/Kingdoms_of_the_Dump/"][/dynamiclink]Please wishlist these titles to support the developers ahead of launch 😊[/p][p][/p][p]So 2025 is absolutely stacked with great titles! I couldn't be more excited for all three games, so I really hope that you can show these amazing devs some love if their games appeal to you 🙏[/p][p][/p][h1]Another great RPG coming soon[/h1][p]While not a part of Infinite Alliance, I did also want to mention that Jimmy and the Pulsating Mass is coming soon to all major consoles with new content, courtesy of Electric Airship - the same publisher which is supporting Infinite Allliance. [/p][p][/p][p]There's no release date yet, but check out their mailing list to stay up-to-date:[/p][p][url="https://airport.electricairship.com/jimmy/"]https://airport.electricairship.com/jimmy/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for supporting all of our wonderful developers everyone!

notes.title: List of Games + FAQ!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Infinite Alliance, everyone! Thank you all so much for the incredible support and excitement we've seen over the last few days.

I've noticed a lot of similar questions popping up, so I wanted to take a moment to share answers in a proper Steam post.

[b]Infinite Alliance[/b] is a story rich, turn-based JRPG crossover, uniting 13+ indie games in a FREE adventure! 

[b]It's coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch 1 & 2, PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox One, & Xbox Series X|S in 2026![/b]

[h2]It's free?[/h2]
[b]It is![/b] This project has been created to showcase and celebrate the work of the Indie JRPG scene (even though we're just a small portion of what's out there). So we didn't want any barriers to entry, as we hope players will discover some new favourite games through this collaboration. That's why we decided to make it completely free for everyone!

On Steam, the goal is for it to be 100% free. On consoles, we're required to offer some kind of purchases, and so we'll have a handful of optional DLCs. All proceeds from these purchases will go to charity.

[h2]So how can I support the project?[/h2]
I've been incredibly humbled by how many people have asked me this. [b]The best way to support Infinite Alliance is to buy and wishlist the games involved.[/b]

9 games on the list below have already been released on Steam (with several on console too), and the 5 upcoming titles would love your wishlists! Quartet is launching in August, and another 3 games are targeting a 2025 release. So we all greatly appreciate your support! 😊

[h2]Which games are involved in this project (so far)? Links?[/h2]
13+ Indie Games are involved in Infinite Alliance, with more announcements to come! I'll list them in alphabetical order, in case anyone's looking for something specific.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1664240/Venaitura/
[h2]Do I need to have played all the games to understand Infinite Alliance?[/h2]
Not at all! Infinite Alliance has been written as an introduction to these characters and their games, so no prior experience is necessary. We hope to intrigue new players through strong story-telling and gameplay.

[h2]Are any more games going to be announced for this collaboration?[/h2]
Yes! While you've seen the bulk of the titles involved, we still have a few more surprises to reveal closer to release. Their involvement will be a little different from what you've seen so far, but it'll add to the celebration and hopefully create even more excitement 😊

[h2]Who's behind Infinite Alliance?[/h2]
